en.title: F
en.summary: The letter name is Ef, as in the word Fisch.

sections.title: Letter Ef sound
paragraphs: The letter name is (Ef) /ɛf/. Its main sound is heard in the word (Fisch) /fɪʃ/, which means fish. This letter makes only one sound.

sections.title: Mouth shape
paragraphs: Rest your top teeth lightly on your lower lip. Blow air gently through the small gap between them. Keep your vocal cords still. Touch your throat to feel that it does not shake. Your voice stays off completely.

sections.title: Spelling rules
paragraphs: This letter always makes the same sound in all positions. You hear it at the start of a word in (finden) /ˈfɪndn̩/. You also hear it written twice at the end of (Schiff) /ʃɪf/.

sections.title: Avoiding mistakes
paragraphs: There is no real pitfall with this sound. It sounds just like the letter in fish or off. Just keep your voice completely off. Do not turn it into the buzzing sound heard in vine.
